evidence: Artificial intelligence and machine learning are new and emerging technologies and could ultimately cause harm to our business.
We currently and in the future may leverage internally developed and third-party developed artificial intelligence in certain limited aspects of our business and internal processes.
There can be no assurance that we will realize any potential improvements or enhancements in our business from these technologies.

adoption or development of similar or more advanced technologies by our competitors, including but not limited to artificial intelligence and related technologies, may require that we devote substantial resources to the development of more advanced technology to remain competitive.

attacks leveraging artificial intelligence tools or methods, ransomware, break ins, phishing attacks, social engineering, security breaches or other attacks and similar disruptions that may jeopardize the security of information
ai_positioning.summary: VIRT adopte une posture défensive sur l'IA, reconnaissant son utilisation interne limitée tout en mettant l'accent sur les risques concurrentiels, réglementaires et de cybersécurité liés aux technologies émergentes d'IA et machine learning.
